html:
The Guamares were a Chichimec people of the Bajío and the hills of northern Guanajuato in Mexico in the 1500s. The map pairs them with the Pecchichitane, a name not found in the usual sources.

Spanish writers of the time called the Guamares the bravest and most cunning of the Chichimecs. They raided the silver roads and towns during the Chichimeca War, from about 1550 to 1590. After the peace they were settled in missions and towns, together with Otomí colonists, and they disappear from the record as a separate people. See also Guamares on the modern map.
